QUICK START

Put your work in orbit.

  1. Unzip the project package and copy its files, including .github/workflows, into your GitHub profile repository.
  2. In the included workflow, set COSMOS_USERNAME to your GitHub username.
  3. Open Actions → Update Commit Cosmos → Run workflow. The workflow generates real daily data and your SVG.
  4. Embed dist/cosmos.svg in your profile README. For the public explorer, set Pages → Source → GitHub Actions, add repository variable COSMOS_PAGES=true, then rerun the workflow.

Full instructions, token troubleshooting, and the exact README snippet are in the included README. Import the generated dist/data.json here to preview real data. Counts follow GitHub contribution rules.

This hosted preview starts with clearly labeled sample data. Your GitHub workflow supplies the real activity. No token is entered in this browser.
